commands: updated=$(docker exec postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U hanoi_app -d hanoi_lab -Atc "update orders set status='confirmed', updated_at=now() where id=4 returning id;")
readback=$(docker exec postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U hanoi_app -d hanoi_lab -Atc "select status from orders where id=4;")
deleted=$(docker exec postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U hanoi_app -d hanoi_lab -Atc "delete from orders where id=4 returning id;")
remaining=$(docker exec postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U hanoi_app -d hanoi_lab -Atc "select count(*) from orders where id=4;")
